te_archived.lag_selection: minimum of three per-lag permutation p-values; selected lag and TE are stored

pcmci_legacy.limitation: legacy summary omits the full p-value matrix and does not record its Tigramite environment; adjusted inference cannot be reconstructed from the 80 selected edges

pcmci_current_environment_rerun.family: all finite off-diagonal directed node x lag cells, lag 1..4
pcmci_current_environment_rerun.use_in_thesis: sensitivity audit only; do not replace the historical count because the archived package version and complete p-matrix were not saved

multiple_testing_method.TE: Bonferroni over 270 directed-pair-by-lag tests, using the archived selected minimum p per directed pair; the correction is deliberately conservative and all legacy raw minima are too coarse to pass
multiple_testing_method.PCMCI_current_environment: Holm step-down over the complete 360 off-diagonal directed-pair-by-lag family; exploratory post-selection PCMCI+ p-values do not establish physical causality
